description: This file contains shared utility functions and constants for handling directives in an auto-reply system, including formatting messages, checking permissions, and managing session events.

methods.name: canPersistInternalDirective
methods.description: Determines if an internal directive can be persisted based on message provider, surface, and gateway client scopes.

methods.name: enqueueModeSwitchEvents
methods.description: Enqueues system events when elevated or reasoning levels change in a session.

methods.name: formatElevatedUnavailableText
methods.description: Formats a message indicating that elevated mode is unavailable, including failure details and a link to explain the session.
